title: Create a cluster
intro: This machine becomes the first k3s server (control plane). You can add more machines afterwards.
success: Your cluster is up. Next: add machines from 'Install on other machines', or run 'nodeyard token' on this server.

steps.label: Set it up for high availability (embedded etcd)?
steps.help: Choose yes if you will have 3 or more servers: the cluster then survives one failing. With fewer machines it costs a little memory and gains nothing.

steps.label: Run workloads on this server too?
steps.help: Yes is best for small clusters. No keeps this machine as a dedicated control plane.

steps.label: Which network interface should cluster traffic use?
steps.help: Pick the wired interface connected to your switch.

options.label: Automatic (the one with the default route)
